frontend_smoke.evidence: In-app Browser offline homepage smoke at desktop 1280x720 and mobile 390x844. Baseline reproduction showed the existing validation alert and correct invalid-control focus, but every active radio lacked aria-invalid and an aria-describedby relationship. After the change, an unanswered Question 1 marked all four radios aria-invalid=true and associated them with quizValidation in both viewports; choosing a valid answer cleared both attributes before the existing auto-advance. Desktop birthday QA marked only the missing month, cleared it after selection, then marked only the missing day. Completing the ten questions through the existing birthday Enter-submit path cleared the final semantics, focused previewTitle, rendered the existing 1080x1350 share card, and kept the production API base blank. Both viewports loaded cache revision 20260802-quiz-invalid-semantics-1 with no horizontal overflow or console warnings/errors. Final localhost requests were page/assets only with no API request. Validation copy/decisions, focus, question order/answers, Back, radio auto-advance, preview, share/referral experiment, tracking, API, checkout, and paid-flow behavior were unchanged. This digest invalidates the evidence on later frontend changes.

paid_flow_e2e.evidence: Narrow digest waiver for control-level error semantics in the free quiz under the standing low-risk conversion authority. Only free-quiz validate and clear calls opt into aria-invalid and quizValidation aria-describedby updates; paidValidation calls retain the default false path, and the full-report and other route HTML changes are cache-revision synchronization only. The change does not alter validation copy/decisions, focus, question order, answer persistence, Back behavior, radio auto-advance timing, tracking payloads, checkout creation, payment verification, paid-answer submission, webhook handling, queueing, report generation, Resend delivery, or customer responses. Regression coverage asserts that no paidValidation call opts in. Offline desktop/mobile Browser QA covered radio and field-specific error/clear paths plus full free-preview completion with the production API base blank, rendered the existing share card, and made no API request. No Lemon Squeezy transaction, webhook, report, or email was created; production payment/email E2E remains separately unauthorized, so this waiver is SKIPPED evidence rather than payment or fulfillment proof. Any later paid-flow digest change invalidates this waiver.
